task.description:
Design comprehensive test specs and test source coverage for OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 based on implemented backend changes. Include:
- happy-path and failure-path cases for lifecycle APIs
- idempotency retry/dedup cases
- transactional compensation rollback ordering cases
- audit redaction assertions for secrets/passwords/MFA seeds
- service-account isolation and token rotation grace-window behavior
- bootstrap one-time enable/disable and manual re-enable path
- federation + attribute mapping behavior
- readiness degraded/recovered behavior
- provider metrics presence and label expectations

Write requirement-linked specs under tests/specs/ and any required concrete test files in the appropriate backend test locations according to test guide conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Each OIDC-16..26 requirement has at least one explicit test case mapping
MUST requirements have executable test coverage, no skipped MUST tests
Integration tests target real PostgreSQL and real platform surfaces (no fake subsystem for MUST coverage)
Specs clearly identify expected pass/fail evidence

result.summary: Test specs and executable test coverage for OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 were added across unit and real-PostgreSQL integration layers, including lifecycle API surfaces, idempotency, transactional rollback ordering, audit redaction persistence, service-account isolation schema constraints, secret-rotation overlap/finalization, bootstrap disable/re-enable, federation alias behavior, readiness degraded/recovered checks, and provider metric label assertions.
